result.summary: The screen is generally coherent, but several rendering problems stand out: a hero image stuck in a loading spinner state, restaurant names truncated without ellipsis in the horizontal carousel, and a second 'Popular right now' card clipped by the bottom navigation bar so its title/metadata is unreachable. A few smaller styling and contrast issues also appear.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image still shows a centered loading spinner overlaying the artwork, suggesting the image load never resolved (or the spinner is not dismissed once the image renders).
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator on image onLoad/onError, and add a static placeholder or skeleton instead of a persistent spinner over a rendered image.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge and its title is hard-truncated with no ellipsis, so the name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis with a single-line clamp, and add proper carousel padding/peek so partially visible cards look intentional.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza, −20%) is clipped by the fixed bottom navigation bar; its title, rating and delivery info are not visible and the list appears to end abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the bottom nav height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the pizza card uses a dark translucent circle with a dark outline icon, giving poor contrast, while the ramen card uses a white circle — inconsistent treatment.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single style (e.g. white circle with dark outline icon) and ensure at least 3:1 contrast against varying image backgrounds.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no visible affordance (fade or arrow) indicating it scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a gradient fade or partial chip peek plus scroll snapping to signal additional categories.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' badge on the ramen image duplicates the '€0 delivery' text in the card metadata line, creating redundant information.
issues.suggestion: Show the promotional badge only, or remove it from the metadata row to avoid duplication.

issues.description: The notification bell shows an unlabeled red dot and the icon-only buttons (bell, hearts) have no visible text label, which may lack accessible names for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide aria-labels/content descriptions such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites'.
